visual_inspection.type: Internal screenshot inspection during development; not external human peer review
visual_inspection.outcome: The final desktop/mobile figures, layout, labels, spacing and optional 3D views were inspected. Detected axis clipping, label color precedence, joined mobile heading words and simultaneous 2D/3D display were corrected before these final runs.
visual_inspection.limits: Browser touch emulation is not a physical mobile-device test. Targeted accessibility checks and screenshot inspection are not a full accessibility conformance audit.

fresh_screenshot_identity_check.scope: The fresh screenshots reproduce the previously inspected image bytes exactly. No new visual differences were inferred from source equivalence alone.

artifact_note: All 33 screenshots per run are enumerated in the retained original summaries. Eight selected Chromium screenshots are included here; remaining screenshots and runtime logs stay in the named ignored build directories. Published paths are repository-relative.
normal_operation: Both runs had zero page/console errors and zero nonlocal resource requests. The separately recorded unavailable-WebGL test deliberately causes a renderer error; the application catches it and preserves its 2D explanation.
rendering_note: Chromium used actual WebGL2 through ANGLE/SwiftShader software rendering. Microsoft Edge used actual WebGL2 through ANGLE/D3D11 on the installed GPU. Both rendered nonblank scenes and passed orbit, zoom, reset, keyboard and touch tests.
